title: The Refuge
kicker: A prosperous Sablewood settlement where hazard rate becomes money, reputation, and a quiet measure of who survives the route.
hook: A prosperous Sablewood settlement where hazard rate becomes money, reputation, and a quiet measure of who survives the route.

blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: The Refuge is prosperous because people learned how to survive Sablewood, not because Sablewood became safe.

blocks.label: Known For

blocks.label: Food And Texture
blocks.body: Soup is the whole welcome, thick and hot and pressed on you before you have sat down. The blankets smell of woodsmoke. There is bread, and broth, and the particular kindness of people who were once the ones arriving...
